title: Offer the CryptoProvider / WebPkiSupportedAlgorithms change as a contribution
design:
Making that type verifier-neutral helps ANY third-party verifier, not just this one, which is what makes it worth offering on its own terms rather than as part of a proposal about us.

Filed separately from the integration epic's other work on purpose: it is the item most likely to buy standing, and it is useful whether or not anything else in that epic happens. A contribution that helps the ecosystem is a different conversation from asking the ecosystem to adopt our verifier.

Context from this session: pkix-rustls 0.1.0 exists and implements rustls's ServerCertVerifier without a CryptoProvider, which is what established that the type is the friction point rather than a convenience. That experience is the evidence for the PR -- we found the seam by having to work around it.

Should be drafted as 'here is a change that makes third-party verifiers possible', with our own verifier as the motivating example rather than the ask.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] The change scoped against current rustls, not against the version pkix-rustls was written for
[ ] Written as an ecosystem improvement with us as the example
[ ] Offered upstream
[ ] Useful to a third-party verifier that is not ours -- stated, and checked against at least one other
